running_thesis: The Nasdaq-100 fell 2.67% on 16 Nov (S&P 500 -1.92%) on Nvidia-led AI selling while yields eased (10-year 5.12%). VIX 22.91, VXN 32.9, COR1M 16.42. Polymarket has a 25 bps December hike at 92.5% and 50+ bps at 4.7%. Nvidia reports after the close Tue 17 Nov with an implied move of 8% to 8.5%, its first call since the CEO resigned. Retail sales (14:30 CET) and FOMC minutes (Wed 20:00 CET) are the other catalysts. Credit showed no stress as of 13 Nov (HY OAS 3.23). Oil data are stale.
open_questions: Does Nvidia's guidance or succession commentary stop or extend the AI selloff?
Does retail sales or the FOMC minutes shift the December hike odds?
Does rising COR1M signal contagion beyond tech?
Is the 5 Nov drop of 6.36% fully digested?
